interface_semantics.actual_start_fence: Actual Docker start remains inside dispatch_guard held across IO by original Engine mutex, with every PG transaction committed/exited before IO. Inside the context first strict inspect exact canonical name/four owner labels/original Broker label, require immutable ID==actual create.stdout ID and state created. After all potentially slow inspect IO, the final noncharging authority.peek must dynamically re-read latest committed PG Run/source/policy/lease/session/config and PG current-time/expiry, finish its short transaction, then compare lease id/hash/request epoch immediately before immutable-ID start; no intervening slow IO. A cached lease or guard-enter-only read is invalid. All-None old behavior stays unchanged.
interface_semantics.known_identity_before_io: Engine commits exact deterministic name+four labels+request_sha operation intent before any create. Bound launch validates the actual create.stdout immutable64hex ID; unknown/invalid ID, missing/mismatched/replaced/not-created observation or inspect daemon/transport failure raises OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and preserves intent/slots. The subsequent actual start uses only that validated immutable ID. Crash recovery queries the original name/labels, never blind reruns launch.
interface_semantics.strict_query: Docker container inspect structured canonical Name, immutable ID, complete mgar.sa12.* owner labels and State; require exact four owner fields plus original Broker label. Only exact name-specific NoSuchContainer/Object message, return1 and empty stdout is definite missing. Other process results/JSON issues raise OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; original _docker transport/timeout DomainError also propagates and must be treated as UNKNOWN, never absence or releasable resources.
interface_semantics.strict_stop: Inspect exact ownership, rm -f by matched immutable container ID, then strictly re-inspect canonical name; only definite missing returns. A replacement with changed owner is never deleted. Unknown/mismatch never frees slots
interface_semantics.label_validation: Exact server label set: mgar.sa12.assignment/operation/workspace are canonical UUID strings, mgar.sa12.project is nonempty bounded server project identifier. Name equals mgar-sa12- plus operation UUID hex. Actual complete mgar.sa12.* labels must equal this four-field map; original mgar.v4.h04.broker=1 also required; unrelated image labels allowed. None comes from HTTP/source/model.
interface_semantics.not_proven: Not yet tested; stderr absence classification requires real Docker missing/daemon-denied negative cases in first new integration checks; no current H06 PASS claim for hooks
interface_semantics.dynamic_authority_source_requirement: The bound CapabilityAuthority MUST use Root-provided dynamic lease_source, not a fixed in-memory lease or cached guard-entry snapshot. Every final peek rechecks current PG lease/session/config/source/Run authority and database current time, commits/exits its short transaction before returning; authority expiry/fence errors deny start and retain intent/slots. peek never charges the operation/model budget.
